History: round 1 (rrn-8479af60445e994b) refused a cache keyed by repository state (F1-F5); the maintainer chose a redesign by input closure. Round 2 (rrn-3f0fc8ba917344df) was refused because the note asked the reviewer to write a TMPDIR. What changed (commit 9ef94ea5, `pose-mcp/internal/pose/index_material_kept.go`): F6 the resolver stays bound to the isolated operation by `withGovernanceReadView`, and `replayMaterialClosure` routes each read through `op.route` like a normal read, so a dependency root's view is opened as on a normal read, and the read must land in the root it was made in. F7 `buildIsolatedMaterial` sets the base root to the requested store's root. F8 `keptMaterialKey` names the engine, project, store root, whether the resolver carries an authorization function, the registry's configuration, each project's root or StoreFor error, and its conflicts. Authorization is per-call policy in the MCP server (`federatedArtifactResolver` evaluates the caller's policy and audits each decision), so it cannot be keyed: the isolated build records every decision its `Authorize` consulted (`recordingAuthorization`), and a hit asks each one again (`sameAuthorization`) before the replay; any different answer rebuilds. A first F8 fix that refused to keep any resolver with `Authorize` turned the cache off in production (148 s on the second harne8 call) and was replaced. Tests use the real federated builder with a foreign dependency in git: `TestIndexMaterialClosureCoversTheForeignDependency`, `TestIndexMaterialOfAForeignRootIsKeptForThatRoot`, `TestIndexMaterialIsNotKeptAcrossAuthorizationOrRegistry` (including a referenced but unregistered project whose decision changes no read); each fails when its fix is reverted. Measured on harne8 (pose-dist at 7e46b1e) after these fixes: second `pose_closeout_state` call 45 s, terminal.

Judge: whether any outcome of the material still depends on something neither the closure, the key nor the recorded decisions cover; whether replaying the decisions before the closure, and auditing them in the current call, is sound; whether concurrent operations can race on the kept map or the decision record. Prior findings: state in `prior_findings` whether each of F1-F8 is resolved.

Building: this review runs under a read-only sandbox, so nothing can be built or written, not even a TMPDIR; do not try, and do not stop the review over it. Do NOT run `pose assess`, `pose state`, `pose index` or anything else that writes under `.pose/`; dispose assess-* tools from the sealed evidence and the code. Leave the worktree as you found it.
